enforced: Closed assetRole enums and compliance pins (schema + semantic_validate.py)
convention: Reference tokens by path, never by raw value (no mechanism in a PageSpec can carry a raw value)

rawValueRestrictions.color: No raw hex/rgb: reference color.* or semantic.*
rawValueRestrictions.fontFamily: Only the three rendered stacks: sans, mono, prose (Geist is declared but never applied; do not ship Geist)
rawValueRestrictions.radius: Only the radius scale; 6px for buttons, 8px for cards, 12px for demo/plan cards
rawValueRestrictions.elevation: Only the listed shadows; no shadows on standalone pages other than the dialog

overrides.note: GAP, stated plainly (MASTER-GUIDE 3.21): this PageSpec schema has no per-instance style or token-override field. Styling is owned entirely by section/component contracts, so there is nothing at the PageSpec layer to validate or mutate. Token concerns are checked at the catalog/policy layer by verify_all.py (catalog recompute, policy key resolution, alias resolution) with a drift-injection test.

themes.dark: not rendered on any measured route; none shipped
